description: List the confirmed attendees of one of the organization's events — name, email, ticket tier, and whether the registration is paid. Use it to answer 'how many people are coming', to check whether someone is registered, or to summarize ticket sales. Unfinished (draft) registrations are excluded. Returns attendee personal data, so do not paste it anywhere the user did not ask for. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: list_registrations
title: List an event's registrations
